features.title: Ask and answer a child-agent question
features.summary: A child asks its direct parent with bounded context and a recommendation policy; only the parent can deliver the answer.
failureModes: A duplicate operation carries conflicting answer data.

features.title: Resolve question expiry safely
features.summary: Expiry either returns the recommended choice or writes a private deferred Markdown record without treating it as an answer.
failureModes: Unsafe path, symlink, or overwrite is rejected.
Repeated defer does not create duplicate records.

features.title: Submit and resolve anchored Markdown feedback
features.summary: Submit line-anchored feedback against the current document revision and deliver accepted, rejected, or deferred resolution receipts to the child.
failureModes: A changed, unreadable, or unsafe Markdown target makes the receipt stale.
Feedback delivery failure is reported without applying stale content.

features.title: Resolve feedback in bounded batches
features.summary: Accept at most twenty feedback resolutions atomically and reject oversized batches before writing any receipt.
failureModes: A batch above the maximum is rejected before mutation.
A stale target cannot be automatically re-anchored.
